title: session result
description: Offline proposed gift-work shortlist; source snapshot remains untrusted and actions are never authorized.

used_during_command.description: after.used - before.used; null when the snapshots cannot be compared

approval.description: Source approval from the default-branch .agent-contrib.json policy; never execution authorization

discover_failed_entry.description: A repository in a multi-repository run whose discovery raised

exclusions.description: Excluded labels (lowercase) and "issue is not open"; any entry excludes the issue

duplicates.description: Open PRs referencing or overlapping the issue; any entry blocks execution

complete.description: False when a read failed or a page, PR-detail or total read cap was reached

reads.description: GitHub reads made for this issue; at most 30

demotions.description: Merged same-repository fix or current assignee; claim comments never demote

top_check.description: Present only for the top N candidates checked by --check-top; report only

repositories.description: One result per requested repository, in request order

complete.description: True only when every repository is complete

candidates.description: Merged order of every issue across repositories

requested_repository.description: Repository named on the command line

issue_source_repository.description: Repository whose tracker was read; null when unresolved

proposed_target_repository.description: Proposed contribution target; context, never authority

ordering.description: Present with --signals: how issues are sorted

repository.description: Issue source repository that was read

complete.description: False when any read failed; missing data is never permission

spec_paths.description: Markdown spec/doc paths in the tree

policy_state.description: State of .agent-contrib.json at the snapshot commit

proposed_target_pulls.description: Null when the target is the issue source

complete.description: Every checked issue was read completely; false sets exit 1

top_check.description: Present with --check-top N: bounded ownership reads for the top N; a demoted one moves below every other candidate that is not excluded or overlapping

discover_result.description: One repository was resolved and read

requested_repository.description: Repository named on the command line

issue_source_repository.description: Repository whose tracker was read; null when unresolved

proposed_target_repository.description: Proposed contribution target; context, never authority

discover_unresolved.description: The repository could not be resolved or its snapshot read

reason.description: "Explicit reference to this issue" or a heuristic overlap naming the shared words/IDs

repository.description: Repository of the PR, when it is not the issue source

observed_in.description: Only in schema 0.2 verify: the match was first seen in a host-context 0.2 disposition read, not the open-PR list scan

duplicate.description: An open PR that references or overlaps the issue

hints.description: Repository paths matched from the issue text

named_paths_missing.description: Repository-relative file paths named in the issue text that are not in the snapshot tree (exact comparison; report only)

value.description: Null when the issue payload lacks or malforms the field

labels.description: Issue label names (sanitized), as used by the demotion rules

assignees.description: Present only with --check-top: current assignee logins from the issue list payload (sanitized, at most 10)

reasons.description: One entry per matched label group or meta-like title

demotion.description: Documented label and title demotions; each subtracts 2 from the score

local_work.description: Present with --repo-dir; a referenced issue ranks below other candidates that are not excluded or overlapping

score.description: code_location found (1) + acceptance clarity (0-2) + maintainer author (1, not for a meta-like title) - 2 per demotion, floored at 0

issue_signals.description: Added by --signals; report-only heuristics, never approval

list_scan.description: Completeness of one paginated GitHub list read

error.description: Why the snapshot failed; null when it succeeded

rate_limit_snapshot.description: Core REST rate-limit snapshot; the counters are null when error is set

parent.description: Immediate fork parent, when it was read

reason.description: How the issue tracker was chosen, or "unresolved"

repository.description: Null when discovery did not resolve the source

external_merge_rate.description: external_merged / external_closed, when value is measured

responsiveness.description: Added by --responsiveness; one-page sample of recently closed PRs, report only

target_pulls_scan.description: Open-PR scan of the proposed target repository when it differs from the issue source

identity_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the original repository/path or URL; display text may be shortened or sanitized
SHA-256 of the original repository/path or URL; display text may be shortened or sanitized

blob_sha.description: The pinned Git blob id of an unread file; null for references

identity_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the original repository/path or URL; display text may be shortened or sanitized

blob_sha.description: The pinned Git blob id of an unread file; null for references

limits_hide_sources.description: A limit hid a policy candidate or reference, or omitted_sources is non-empty

id.description: Stable ID: H- and the SHA-256 of (source identity_sha256, line, kind); unchanged by report order

excerpt_truncated.description: The excerpt omits text before or after it

inventory_format.description: Version of the inventory_sha256 input; 1 was the unversioned hash of earlier 0.3.0 candidates

hinted_lines.description: One reading entry per hinted source line, in attention order; kinds lists every hint kind on the line

project_vocabulary.description: Lines whose only hints are mentions made of the project name (for example agent in acme/agent-kit); never restrictions

owner_lookup.description: Outcome of the owner .github lookup; unavailable (not a 404) is a hiding limit. Null when not attempted.

repository_policy.description: Default-on, report-only policy inventory and hints; never a verdict

complete.description: False when the checkout or base could not be read or the commit limit was reached; sets exit 1

base.description: Source default-branch commit of the snapshot

local_work.description: Present with --repo-dir: issues referenced by local commits not in the source default branch; report only

requested_limit.description: Requested display budget (1-1000), shared globally in a multi-repository run

total_issues_considered.description: Successfully inspected observed entries before display projection; not inaccessible or malformed issues

omitted.description: Observed entries omitted by the display budget

truncated.description: Whether display entries were omitted; independent of scan completeness

overlapping.description: Overlapping entries in the full observed list, including omitted entries

excluded.description: Excluded entries in the full observed list, including omitted entries

discovery_display.description: Only with --limit. Counts describe observed candidates, never source approval or read completeness. Multi-repository totals count requested-repository entries, even when they resolve to the same tracker.
